items.title: Live: Iran launches fresh missiles at Israel, dismisses Trump's talk of negotiations as 'fake news'
items.description: US President Donald Trump says there have been "major points of agreement" in US-Iran talks to end the war, but Iran denies those claims. Follow live.

items.title: Diesel standards relaxed as extent of service station shortages revealed
items.description: Australia is temporarily lowering standards for diesel to allow more supply into the domestic market as service stations across the country continue to experience localised shortages.

items.title: Iran launches longest-ever ballistic missile reaching beyond Middle East
items.description: An attempted attack on a US-UK military base in the Indian Ocean by Iran shows Tehran can launch missiles as far as 4,000km, raising concerns European cities are in reach.

items.title: Oil price soars again as TACO Tuesday proves unpalatable
items.description: A key factor for shares, bonds, commodities and currencies remains consistently unchanged — the Strait of Hormuz is still effectively closed.

items.title: Are you 'panic buying' or 'playing it safe'?
items.description: If you've topped up your tank at a petrol station recently did it feel like you were "panic buying"?

items.title: Former defence leaders say Australia is already in a fight with its biggest threats
items.description: Australians are already deeply emersed in a global disinformation war about fossil fuels and climate change, former defence leaders say in an extensive new review.

items.title: Farmers rubbish 'worst ever' EU free trade agreement
items.description: The National Farmers' Federation says the deal will leave farmers without meaningful access to the EU market.

items.title: Trump Organization paid for Tom Tate's meals and more during visit
items.description: The Gold Coast mayor visited the luxurious estate days before an Australian developer signed a deal to build a Trump-branded tower at Surfers Paradise.

items.title: Shock election result likely as anti-Trump sentiment reaches Denmark
items.description: When Donald Trump threatened to annex Greenland, Denmark leader Mette Frederiksen was flailing in the polls. Having stood up to the US president, she looks to have salvaged her political career.

items.title: Labor caucus chooses new cabinet ministers as Liberals pledge election review
items.description: As SA Liberal leader Ashton Hurn pledged to review the weekend's catastrophic defeat for her party, the Labor caucus met for the first time since its resounding win, with the premier hitting back at remarks made by One Nation's Pauline Hanson.

items.title: Teenage girl hospitalised after shocking beachside attack filmed
items.description: A 14-year-old girl is speaking out against bullying after she was hospitalised with injuries sustained in a beachside attack.

items.title: Tropical Cyclone Narelle to re-form and possibly intensify to category four
items.description: Coastal communities in the Kimberley region will be affected in the next 24 hours as Tropical Cyclone Narelle, which had been downgraded to a low, intensifies back to cyclone level.

items.title: Man facing trial over Easey Street murders charged with rape
items.description: Prosecutors have reinstated a rape charge against accused Easey Street killer Perry Kouroumblis after a magistrate had earlier struck out the offence.

items.title: Broncos 'surprised' as key cog resigns after dispute with coach
items.description: Brisbane defensive coach Ben Te'o, the mastermind behind the scrambling defence in the 2025 grand final win, hands in his resignation.

items.title: The Diary of Anne Frank's 'uplifting' theatre production arrives at the right time
items.description: While considering it a "big responsibility" bringing the theatre production to Sydney at this time, actress Chloe-Jean Vincent says Anne Frank's story makes theatregoers feel "inspired and so uplifted".

items.title: Suns' woes compounded as Humphrey fails to overturn ban at tribunal
items.description: Young gun Bailey Humphrey will miss Gold Coast's next two matches through suspension, after the AFL tribunal rejects his arguments against a rough conduct ban.

items.title: How Bron Lewis speed ran the Australian comedy scene
items.description: The crimson-haired comedian has gone from tiny open mics to the biggest stage in Melbourne in just a few short years.

items.title: 'Birthkeeper' may be forced to give evidence about influencer's freebirth death
items.description: A coroner investigating the death of nutrition influencer Stacey Warnecke after a freebirth may compel her support worker to appear at the inquest.

items.title: I was in so much pain, I couldn't interact the same ways as other mums
items.description: Megan Blin says her chronic pain made it difficult to do things other first-time mums could.

items.title: Canberra Liberals fail in bid to reduce public transport fares to 50 cents
items.description: The Canberra Liberals introduced the motion for public transport fares to be temporarily cheaper to alleviate pressure on households while fuel prices soar, but it did not receive the support of the assembly.

items.title: Teachers in Victoria go on strike for the first time in 13 years
items.description: Some 35,000 people gathered for a rally in Melbourne CBD as teachers, principals and education support staff statewide stopped work for 24 hours.

items.title: BOM website creator's new $16m contract has climate scientists worried
items.description: The company responsible for the highly criticised BOM website wins a $16 million tender to build a new climate data website for the government.

items.title: Iran fuel shock turns EV uptake into a matter of national security
items.description: From UN leaders to former Australian Defence Force chiefs, a growing chorus of voices argues that dependence on fossil fuels is not just a climate issue, but a national security risk — exposing countries to volatile prices and supply shocks.

items.title: 'Blue blob' vandal who gave sculpture googly eyes ordered to pay compensation
items.description: A 20-year-old woman who made headlines by putting googly eyes on a controversial sculpture in the middle of Mount Gambier is ordered to pay $2,000 to the city's council.

items.title: 'Much loved' mayor dies by voluntary assisted dying after cancer battle
items.description: The prime minister has paid tribute to the former Labor member and regional mayor, hailing her as a trailblazer.
